---
title: "Copyright and source-file policy"
---

This archive is a citation and annotation project. It is not a wholesale document dump.

## Repository license is not a source-document license

Original writing, configuration, and scripts in this repository are [CC BY 4.0](../about.qmd). That licence **does not** attach to third-party historical documents.

If a PDF or scan later appears under `documents/`, assume it keeps its original copyright, Crown copyright, or unknown-rights status unless the matching source page documents a specific permission.

## Default handling

For material that may still be copyrighted, record:

1. Metadata and a short annotation
2. A bibliographic citation (`references.bib`)
3. A stable public link, when one exists
4. An archived-link field, when an archived copy already exists

Do **not** copy every historical PDF into the repository.

## When a file may be hosted

Commit a file under [`documents/`](https://github.com/jordanforge-ca/csil-history/blob/main/documents/README.md) only when redistribution is clearly permitted and the permission or licence is quoted on the source page (`rights_note`).

Clear permission means one of:

- public domain
- written permission from the copyright holder for this reproduction
- a licence on the work that expressly allows redistribution of the copy we host
- a Crown or government copyright notice that clearly allows this reproduction

## When a file must not be hosted

- private CSIL employer records
- personal health information
- unpublished private correspondence
- private-chat or private-repo material
- scans with unknown rights
- library or archival copies that are restricted

## Fair dealing / quotation

Short quotation for identification or a specific cited claim may be acceptable. Do not paste chapters, manuals, or evaluation reports into Markdown.

## Contributor reminder

If rights are unclear, open an issue describing the source **without** attaching the file.
